## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npx vitest run`, `npx nuxt typecheck`, `npx nuxt build` in `api/`; `npm run generate` in `docs-site/` if the docs changed)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (desktop and phone width)
- [ ] Docs: English, German and Spanish pages have the same structure (`docs-site/content/en|de|es`)
- [ ] API changes are documented in `api/API.md`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or real user data in the diff
